title: VISIO portfolio
description: Public works, newest first. Captions name a neighbourhood or area and a city. They do not include a street or a house number. Agent names may stay in the title.

title.description: Neighbourhood or area, then city. Example: רובע ה׳, אשדוד. No street.

sub.description: Short feature line, such as מרפסת · סלון · מטבח.

partner.description: Stored for filtering only. Never rendered on a card.

hero.description: Public path of the card image, usually /portfolio/<slug>/cover.jpg.

matterport.description: Matterport model id. Omitted when the card opens a tour hosted on this site.

tour.description: Slug under public/tours/. The card opens /tours/<slug>.

fit.description: Use contain when the still has a banner that must not be cropped.
